\label{result: lemma L1 convergence}
	With $\varphi_t$ as defined above then $\varphi_t \overset{L_1}{\rightarrow} \varphi_T$.

title: Proof
body_md: Note that for each $t \in [0,T)$ we have $\mathbb{E}^{\mathbb{Q}}[\varphi_t]<\infty$ as well as $\varphi_t \overset{}{\rightarrow} \varphi_T$ almost surely by Lemma~\ref{result: almost sure convergence of guided bridge}. The result then follows from the uniform integrability of $\left\{\varphi_t \colon t \in [0,T)\right\}$, which can be found in Appendix C.2 in \cite{thompson2015submanifold}.
